name: Worldz Universal FlyWheel™
purpose: Ensure legacy Worldz assets, previously launched official Worldz tokens, future official Worldz tokens and verified WorldzLaunchPad projects receive continuing shared ecosystem benefits without adding a hidden trader fee or promising investment returns.

coverage.noTokenLeftBehindRule: Every eligible registered project receives a cycle benefit record. Shared infrastructure benefits apply platform-wide. Token-specific liquidity, grants, supply actions or burns require that project's disclosed manifest, compatible token standard and required authority.

mandatorySharedBenefits: Worldz Proof and transparent launch records

worldzLaunchPadShare.use: Funds shared Worldz infrastructure and approved Universal FlyWheel support. Internal spending does not alter the disclosed 51/17/15/8.5/8.5 fee split.

oneWorldzImpactShare.use: Continues as the separate impact/charity funding lane with public accounting.

cycle.name: Worldz Universal Cycle™
steps: snapshot the verified project registry and all eligible official/legacy assets
reconcile collected Worldz-controlled fees by source project and chain
fund the existing 6-hour Legacy Flywheel entitlements independently
fund shared infrastructure/security/identity/proof services from the WorldzLaunchPad share
create one benefit record for every eligible registered token
evaluate token-specific liquidity, grant or burn proposals only where manifest and authority permit
simulate every executable transaction before signature
require the configured wallet or multisig approvals
publish Worldz Proof receipts and carry unused balances forward

fairness.directFinancialSupportPolicy: When a cycle has a distributable token-support pool, allocation rules must be published before that cycle. A project may receive zero direct financial support while still receiving the mandatory shared platform benefits.
fairness.antiWhaleRule: No project may obtain all shared support solely because it generated the most fees.

burnStandard.name: Worldz ProofBurn™
burnStandard.rule: Worldz never assumes it can burn a token. A burn requires token units controlled by the project's disclosed burn-capable reserve, a compatible chain-native burn path, simulation, authorized signature and a public receipt.

chainRule: Shared benefits can be recorded for every supported chain. Token-specific execution occurs only through a verified chain-native adapter; no unsupported bridge, burn, vesting or liquidity action is implied.
